title: Frequently Asked Questions
q1: How does UstoGo verify master craftsmen?
a1: Every applicant undergoes mandatory state license checks, identity verification, 10-year criminal background screening, and past client reference audits.
a2: Payment is pre-authorized when you book, but funds are held securely in escrow and released to the master only after you sign off on job completion.
q3: What if I need to cancel or reschedule?
a3: You can reschedule or cancel free of charge up to 2 hours before the scheduled appointment time directly from your Client Dashboard.
q4: Is there a guarantee on the work performed?
a4: Yes! All services booked on UstoGo are covered by our $1,000,000 UstoGo Protection & Satisfaction Guarantee.
